tables.name: customer
tables.description: Stores basic information about each customer in the bank.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Unique ID for each customer (Primary Key)

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Date the customer record was created

tables.name: account
tables.description: Stores account-level information for each customer.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer linked to this account (Foreign Key)

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: Type of account (Savings, Current, Loan, etc.)

columns.name: opened_date
columns.description: Date when the account was opened

columns.name: status
columns.description: Status of the account (Active, Closed, Frozen, etc.)

tables.name: transaction_intent
tables.description: Stores details about user transaction intents.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer associated with the intent (Foreign Key)

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Account linked to the intent (Foreign Key)

columns.name: intent_type
columns.description: Type of transaction intent (Deposit, Withdrawal, Transfer, etc.)

tables.name: transaction_history
tables.description: Stores executed financial transactions between accounts.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Account associated with this transaction (Foreign Key)

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description: Type of transaction (Credit, Debit, Transfer, etc.)

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer who owns the loan (Foreign Key)

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: Type of loan (Home, Personal, Vehicle, etc.)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of loan (Active, Closed, Defaulted)
